title: SRS Core Specifications, Personas, and PostgreSQL Data Model
acceptance_criteria: Master SRS index following jam01/SRS-Template and USAID SRS standards in docs/Ediens_SRS.md.
3 detailed Actors/Personas (Meal Prepper, Household Member, Background Nutrition Engine Worker) in 03-product-description.md.
12 Functional Requirements (FR-01 to FR-12) with clear acceptance criteria and priority in 03-product-description.md.
Complete PostgreSQL ER diagram in Mermaid erDiagram syntax and relational table definitions in 07-data-model.md.
Table schemas include xmin rowversion concurrency tokens, outbox_messages table, and idempotency_records table.
